headline: Expiry‑day trades are a major source of loss

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: These expiry‑day trades cost you ₹1,16,891 across 90 trades. On average each of those trades was a loss of ₹1,299, with a win rate of 29% and a 28% loss per trade, while the remaining 124 trades averaged a loss of ₹449, a 5% loss per trade and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule to limit expiry‑day trades in the next window.
